head: Gemini Notebook adds hundreds of free textbooks
dek: Google opened a free catalog of hundreds of textbooks in Gemini Notebook, from OpenStax, the Open Textbook Library and India's S Chand Publishing. Once added, you can ask about chapters and get quizzes, flashcards and study guides.
details: Answers come with citations and links to the passages in the book. Google also recently gave Gemini Notebook a lecture recorder on mobile.
means: If you study from one of these textbooks, you can quiz yourself on it without paying for the book.
todo: Open Gemini Notebook, choose Add sources, then Textbooks, and pick a book.
